command: R="$PWD"; export O="$R/$AB_OUT_DIR"; Q="$(awk '/^---$/{n++;next} n>1' "$R/evals/cases/P02-vocabulary-drift-cancel-terminate/prompt.md")"; mkdir -p /tmp/ab-neutral; cd /tmp/ab-neutral || exit 9; claude -p "$Q" --model claude-sonnet-5 --output-format json --setting-sources "" --strict-mcp-config --tools Read,Glob,Grep,Skill --permission-mode bypassPermissions --max-budget-usd 0.50 < /dev/null > "$O/raw.json"; rc=$?; python3 -c 'import json,os,sys;d=json.load(open(os.environ["O"]+"/raw.json"));(not d.get("is_error")) and open(os.environ["O"]+"/cost.usd","w").write("%.6f" % d["total_cost_usd"]);sys.stdout.write(d.get("result") or "");sys.exit(1 if d.get("is_error") else 0)' || rc=1; exit $rc
